title: Glazed Symmetry Unofficial Port
description: This is an unofficial port of Glazed Symmetry made by iamevn_mc
body:
This project is an unofficial port of Glazed Symmetry originally created by iamevn\_mc.  The original mod was designed for Minecraft 1.16. This project is to update the mod to run on newer Minecraft versions and loaders while preserving the original design, assets, and gameplay intent.

The mod adds additional glazed terracotta block variants for all 16 colors.    
These variants provide centered and pillar-style textures, expanding building options.

Differences from the original:  
- Ported to newer Minecraft version.  
- Internal codebase updated for compatibility and stability.  
- No intentional gameplay or visual changes beyond what is required for the port.

License:  
- This port follows and uses the same license as the original Glazed Symmetry project.  
- Full credit for the original concept, textures, and implementation belongs to iamevn\_mc.    
- This project exists solely to maintain availability and compatibility for current Minecraft versions.
